definition: A subset of data held out from training and used to tune hyperparameters and monitor model performance during development.
details: The validation set provides feedback for model-selection decisions without touching the final test set, helping avoid overfitting to the evaluation data itself.
story: Picture a librarian organizing a million slips of paper so that any one of them can be found in a heartbeat. Here is the short version: A subset of data held out from training and used to tune hyperparameters and monitor model performance during development. The part that makes it sing: The validation set provides feedback for model-selection decisions without touching the final test set, helping avoid overfitting to the evaluation data itself. Garbage in, garbage out — and the reverse: clean, representative data makes the model quietly brilliant. And that is Validation Set — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
